chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: Current job at the Ramada Inn in Fort Collins and preferring fewer nights
summary: Horace is about to play six nights a week at the Ramada Inn in Fort Collins; he would prefer three so he can ride his horses and hear other groups.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Right. Just for the record here, I

think we ought to get it on tape. You are still playing -- well, currently, like you're closing out a job tonight, where you've been playing three nights a week. Right? And you're going into a job on Monday night, which is the day after tomorrow, playing six nights a week.
Yes, at the Ramada Inn in Fort Collins. And I really hate it because it's six nights. I don't like six nights. Not that I'm admitting there (unintelligible) if I have to play seven nights --

-- but I like to do other things too, you know, like go out with my family. And I've got a new little side recreation. I have horses, you know, and I like to spend time with my animals and whatnot. Like if you play three nights or four nights a week, you've got three days to recuperate and get out, and then you can go around and hear other groups. This way, six nights, when you're off on Sunday, you rest, getting ready to go back to work Monday, you know. And it's just one of those things.

But jobs -- good jobs in this particular area now are scarce, so this happens to be a good job that's coming up, so I can't demand a six night -- or a three night, rather. deal like I would want. This is the policy of the Ramada Inn, and they have their clientele, and so I'm willing to go along with it.
